## 1. Common Data Types

### KOLResult

Returned inside any endpoint that returns KOL data.

| Field | Type | Description | Example |
|-------|------|-------------|---------|
| `id` | `int` | Unique KOL identifier | `42` |
| `name` | `str` | KOL display name | `"KOL_42"` |
| `country` | `str` | Target market country code | `"MY"` |
| `category` | `str` | Content category | `"beauty"` |
| `followers` | `int` | Total follower count | `250000` |
| `engagement_rate` | `float` | Historical engagement rate, range 0–1 | `0.0842` |
| `fit_score` | `float` | Cultural fit score for target market, range 0–1 | `0.76` |
| `cost` | `float` | Hiring fee in USD | `1200.00` |
| `expected_gmv` | `float` | Predicted GMV (see data_source.md for formula) | `15966.40` |
| `tier` | `str` | KOL tier classification | `"Micro"` |
| `creator_score` | `float` | Composite score 0–1 | `0.683` |
| `reasons` | `List[str]` | Why this KOL is recommended (≥3 items) | `["High engagement rate", ...]` |

---

### AlgorithmResult

One entry inside the `results` map of `POST /optimize`.

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `algorithm` | `str` | Algorithm display name (see §12) |
| `selected_kols` | `List[KOLResult]` | KOLs selected by this algorithm |
| `selected_count` | `int` | Number of selected KOLs |
| `total_cost` | `float` | Total hiring cost (USD) |
| `total_gmv` | `float` | Total predicted GMV (USD) |
| `roi` | `float` | Return on investment = total_gmv / total_cost |
| `history` | `List[float]` | Best GMV at each iteration step (downsampled to 200 points) |

## 4. POST /optimize

Runs all **six** algorithms on the filtered KOL pool and returns a full comparison plus the best result.

### Request Body

```json
{
  "budget": 5000.0,
  "countries": ["MY", "SG"],
  "category": "beauty",
  "seed": 42
}
```

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Validation |
|-------|------|----------|---------|------------|
| `budget` | `float` | Yes | — | Must be > 0 |
| `countries` | `List[str]` | No | `[]` (all 6) | Each element: `MY`, `ID`, `TH`, `PH`, `SG`, `VN` |
| `category` | `str` | No | `"beauty"` | `beauty`, `fashion`, `home`, `fmcg` |
| `seed` | `int` | No | `42` | 0–9999 |

`countries` accepts zero, one, or multiple country codes. An empty array (`[]`) means **all six countries** — no country filter is applied.

### Response `200 OK`

```json
{
  "budget": 5000.0,
  "countries": ["MY", "SG"],
  "category": "beauty",
  "candidates": 18,
  "best_algorithm": "Simulated Annealing",
  "selected_kols": [ /* KOLResult objects */ ],
  "total_cost": 4780.0,
  "total_gmv": 63450.0,
  "roi": 13.27,
  "results": {
    "simulated_annealing": { /* AlgorithmResult */ },
    "hill_climber":        { /* AlgorithmResult */ },
    "random_search":       { /* AlgorithmResult */ },
    "genetic_algorithm":   { /* AlgorithmResult */ },
    "tabu_search":         { /* AlgorithmResult */ },
    "greedy_ranking":      { /* AlgorithmResult */ }
  }
}
```

| Top-level Field | Type | Description |
|-----------------|------|-------------|
| `budget` | `float` | Echo of the requested budget |
| `countries` | `List[str]` | Echo of the requested countries filter (empty = all) |
| `category` | `str` | Echo of the requested category |
| `candidates` | `int` | Total KOLs in the filtered pool |
| `best_algorithm` | `str` | Name of the algorithm that achieved the highest GMV |
| `selected_kols` | `List[KOLResult]` | KOLs selected by the best algorithm |
| `total_cost` | `float` | Total cost from the best algorithm |
| `total_gmv` | `float` | Total predicted GMV from the best algorithm |
| `roi` | `float` | ROI from the best algorithm |
| `results` | `Dict[str, AlgorithmResult]` | Full results for all six algorithms |

**Error Responses:**

| Condition | Status |
|-----------|--------|
| `budget <= 0` | `422` |
| Invalid `country` | `422` |
| Invalid `category` | `422` |
| No KOLs match filters | `200` with `candidates: 0` |

## 5. GET /kols

Returns a filtered, paginated list of all KOLs in the database.

**Query Parameters:**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|---------|-------------|
| `country` | `str` | No | — | `MY`, `ID`, `TH`, `PH`, `SG`, `VN` |
| `category` | `str` | No | — | `beauty`, `fashion`, `home`, `fmcg` |
| `tier` | `str` | No | — | `Mega`, `Macro`, `Micro`, `Nano` |
| `limit` | `int` | No | `50` | Max results, 1–200 |
| `offset` | `int` | No | `0` | Pagination offset |

**Response `200 OK`:**
```json
{
  "total": 42,
  "limit": 50,
  "offset": 0,
  "kols": [ /* KOLResult objects */ ]
}
```

## 6. GET /kol/{id}

Returns full details for a single KOL including all extended fields.

**Response `200 OK`:**
```json
{
  "id": 7,
  "name": "KOL_7",
  "country": "MY",
  "category": "beauty",
  "followers": 120000,
  "engagement_rate": 0.11,
  "fit_score": 0.85,
  "cost": 750.0,
  "expected_gmv": 11220.0,
  "tier": "Micro",
  "creator_score": 0.712,
  "avg_views": 45000,
  "avg_likes": 3800,
  "gender_ratio": 0.78,
  "age_group": "18-24",
  "reasons": [
    "Malaysia audience match above 80%",
    "Beauty content ratio exceeds 90%",
    "ROI 18% above category average"
  ]
}
```

| Extended Field | Type | Description |
|----------------|------|-------------|
| `avg_views` | `int` | Average video views in last 30 days |
| `avg_likes` | `int` | Average likes per video |
| `gender_ratio` | `float` | Female audience proportion, range 0–1 |
| `age_group` | `str` | Dominant audience age group |

**Error:** `404` if ID not found.

## 7. GET /top-kols

```json
{
  "country": "MY",

  "top_kols": [ /* up to 10 KOLResult objects, sorted by creator_score desc */ ]
}
```

## 8. POST /scalability

Runs all six algorithms on a dynamically generated pool of size `n`.

**Request Body:**
```json
{ "n": 200, "budget": 5000.0, "seed": 42 }
```

| Field | Validation |
|-------|------------|
| `n` | 10–500 |
| `budget` | > 0 |

**Response `200 OK`:**
```json
{
  "n": 200,
  "budget": 5000.0,
  "simulated_annealing": { "time_seconds": 2.34, "total_gmv": 48200.0, "roi": 10.15, "selected_count": 6 },
  "hill_climber":        { "time_seconds": 0.81, "total_gmv": 41300.0, "roi": 8.63,  "selected_count": 4 },
  "random_search":       { "time_seconds": 0.52, "total_gmv": 27800.0, "roi": 5.96,  "selected_count": 3 },
  "genetic_algorithm":   { "time_seconds": 1.73, "total_gmv": 45600.0, "roi": 9.82,  "selected_count": 5 },
  "tabu_search":         { "time_seconds": 0.94, "total_gmv": 43100.0, "roi": 9.34,  "selected_count": 5 },
  "greedy_ranking":      { "time_seconds": 0.03, "total_gmv": 39800.0, "roi": 8.51,  "selected_count": 5 }
}
```

## 9. Creator CRUD

### POST /kols/add

Add a single creator to the database.

**Request Body:**
```json
{
  "name": "KOL_New",
  "country": "MY",
  "category": "beauty",
  "followers": 120000,
  "engagement_rate": 0.11,
  "cost": 750.0,
  "fit_score": 0.85,
  "avg_views": 45000,
  "avg_likes": 3800,
  "gender_ratio": 0.78,
  "age_group": "18-24",
  "tiktok_url": "https://tiktok.com/@example"
}
```

Required: `name`, `country`, `category`, `followers`, `engagement_rate`, `cost`.  
Optional fields default to computed or null values.

**Response `200 OK`:** The created KOL record with assigned `id`.

---

### PUT /kols/{id}

Update an existing creator. Automatically records a metric snapshot to `kol_history.json` before applying changes.

**Request Body:** Same fields as POST /kols/add (all optional — only updated fields need to be included).

**Response `200 OK`:** Updated KOL record.  
**Error:** `404` if ID not found.

---

### DELETE /kols/{id}

Delete a creator.

**Response `200 OK`:** `{ "deleted": true }`  
**Error:** `404` if ID not found.

---

### POST /kols/import-csv

Bulk import creators from a CSV file upload.

**Content-Type:** `multipart/form-data`  
**Field:** `file` — `.csv` file

Required CSV columns: `name, country, category, followers, engagement_rate, cost`  
Optional CSV columns: `fit_score, avg_views, avg_likes, gender_ratio, age_group, tiktok_url`

**Response `200 OK`:**
```json
{ "imported": 45, "failed": 2, "errors": ["Row 3: invalid engagement_rate"] }
```

---

### POST /kols/reset

Clears all creators from the database.

**Response `200 OK`:** `{ "reset": true }`

---

### GET /kols/template

Returns a downloadable CSV template file.

**Response `200 OK`:** CSV file download (`Content-Disposition: attachment`).

---

### GET /kols/export

Exports all creators as a CSV file.

**Response `200 OK`:** CSV file download.

## 10. KOL History Tracking

KOL metric snapshots are recorded automatically whenever a KOL is updated (PUT /kols/{id}), and can also be triggered manually via the simulate-update endpoint.

### GET /kols/{id}/history

Returns all metric snapshots for a KOL, newest first.

**Response `200 OK`:**
```json
{
  "kol_id": 7,
  "count": 2,
  "snapshots": [
    {
      "recorded_at": "2026-06-07T14:23:11",
      "engagement_rate": 0.113,
      "fit_score": 0.87,
      "followers": 123500,
      "commission_rate": 0.18,
      "avg_views": 46200,
      "avg_likes": 3920
    },
    {
      "recorded_at": "2026-06-01T09:05:44",
      "engagement_rate": 0.105,
      "fit_score": 0.84,
      "followers": 120000,
      "commission_rate": 0.18,
      "avg_views": 45000,
      "avg_likes": 3800
    }
  ]
}
```

Returns `{"kol_id": id, "snapshots": [], "count": 0}` if no history exists yet.

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `kol_id` | `int` | KOL identifier |
| `count` | `int` | Total number of snapshots |
| `snapshots` | `List[Snapshot]` | Snapshots, newest first |
| `snapshots[].recorded_at` | `str` | ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the snapshot |
| `snapshots[].engagement_rate` | `float` | Engagement rate at snapshot time |
| `snapshots[].fit_score` | `float` | Fit score at snapshot time |
| `snapshots[].followers` | `int` | Follower count at snapshot time |
| `snapshots[].commission_rate` | `float` | Commission rate at snapshot time |
| `snapshots[].avg_views` | `int` | Average views at snapshot time |
| `snapshots[].avg_likes` | `int` | Average likes at snapshot time |

---

### POST /kols/{id}/simulate-update

Applies a realistic random drift to the KOL's metrics (simulating a TikTok API refresh) and records a snapshot. Drift ranges:

| Metric | Drift Range |
|--------|-------------|
| `engagement_rate` | −8% to +12% |
| `fit_score` | −5% to +8% |
| `followers` | −2% to +6% |

**Request Body:** None required.

**Response `200 OK`:**
```json
{
  "message": "Simulated metric refresh applied",
  "kol_id": 7,
  "changes": {
    "engagement_rate": { "before": 0.105, "after": 0.118 },
    "fit_score":        { "before": 0.84,  "after": 0.87  },
    "followers":        { "before": 120000, "after": 123500 }
  }
}
```

**Error:** `404` if ID not found.

## 11. Campaign Attribution

### POST /campaigns

Save an optimization result as a named campaign for attribution tracking.

**Request Body:**
```json
{
  "name": "MY Beauty June 2026",
  "country": "MY",
  "category": "beauty",
  "budget": 5000.0,
  "best_algorithm": "Simulated Annealing",
  "selected_kols": [
    {
      "id": 7,
      "name": "KOL_7",
      "country": "MY",
      "category": "beauty",
      "followers": 120000,
      "cost": 750.0,
      "predicted_gmv": 11220.0,
      "tier": "Micro"
    }
  ],
  "total_cost": 4780.0,
  "predicted_gmv": 63450.0
}
```

**Response `200 OK`:** Created campaign record with `id` and `status: "active"`.

---

### GET /campaigns

List all campaigns, newest first.

**Response `200 OK`:**
```json
[
  {
    "id": 1,
    "name": "MY Beauty June 2026",
    "country": "MY",
    "category": "beauty",
    "budget": 5000.0,
    "best_algorithm": "Simulated Annealing",
    "total_cost": 4780.0,
    "predicted_gmv": 63450.0,
    "actual_total_gmv": null,
    "accuracy_pct": null,
    "status": "active",
    "created_at": "2026-06-07T14:00:00",
    "completed_at": null,
    "selected_kols": [ /* KOLPrediction objects */ ]
  }
]
```

---

### GET /campaigns/{id}

Get a single campaign by ID.

**Response `200 OK`:** Full campaign record (same schema as above).  
**Error:** `404` if not found.

---

### PUT /campaigns/{id}/actual

Record actual GMV after a campaign ends. Transitions status from `"active"` to `"completed"`.

**Request Body:**
```json
{
  "actual_total_gmv": 58200.0,
  "kol_actuals": [
    { "id": 7, "actual_gmv": 10500.0 }
  ]
}
```

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| `actual_total_gmv` | `float` | Yes | Total GMV actually generated by the campaign |
| `kol_actuals` | `List[KOLActual]` | No | Per-KOL actual GMV breakdown (optional) |

**Response `200 OK`:** Updated campaign record with `accuracy_pct = actual_total_gmv / predicted_gmv × 100`.

---

### DELETE /campaigns/{id}

Delete a campaign.

**Response `200 OK`:** `{ "deleted": true }`  
**Error:** `404` if not found.

## 12. API Integrations

Stub endpoints for future third-party data source connections. All connections currently return `coming_soon`.

### GET /api/connections

Lists all available integrations and their current status.

**Response `200 OK`:**
```json
{
  "connections": [
    { "id": "manual",         "name": "Manual Import",                   "status": "active" },
    { "id": "tiktok_creator", "name": "TikTok Creator Marketplace API",  "status": "coming_soon" },
    { "id": "tiktok_shop",    "name": "TikTok Shop Partner API",         "status": "coming_soon" },
    { "id": "third_party",    "name": "Third-Party Analytics Platforms", "status": "coming_soon" }
  ]
}
```

---

### POST /api/connections/interest

Register an email address for early access to a Coming Soon integration.

**Request Body:**
```json
{
  "email": "merchant@example.com",
  "integration_type": "tiktok_creator"
}
```

| Field | Type | Required | Values |
|-------|------|----------|--------|
| `email` | `str` | Yes | Valid email address |
| `integration_type` | `str` | Yes | `tiktok_creator`, `tiktok_shop`, `third_party` |

**Response `200 OK`:**
```json
{ "status": "registered", "message": "We'll notify you when TikTok Creator Marketplace API becomes available." }
```

---

### POST /api/connections/connect

Attempt to connect an integration with credentials. Returns `coming_soon` until the integration is live.

**Request Body:**
```json
{
  "integration_type": "tiktok_creator",
  "credentials": { "api_key": "...", "api_secret": "..." }
}
```

**Response `200 OK`:**
```json
{ "status": "coming_soon", "message": "TikTok Creator Marketplace API integration is not yet available." }
```

## 13. Enum Reference

### Algorithm Names (display strings in `algorithm` field)

| Key in `results` | Display Name |
|-----------------|--------------|
| `simulated_annealing` | `"Simulated Annealing"` |
| `hill_climber` | `"Hill Climber"` |
| `random_search` | `"Random Search"` |
| `genetic_algorithm` | `"Genetic Algorithm"` |
| `tabu_search` | `"Tabu Search"` |
| `greedy_ranking` | `"Greedy Ranking"` |

### country

| Value | Market |
|-------|--------|
| `MY` | Malaysia |
| `ID` | Indonesia |
| `TH` | Thailand |
| `PH` | Philippines |
| `SG` | Singapore |
| `VN` | Vietnam |

### category

| Value | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `beauty` | Beauty & personal care |
| `fashion` | Clothing, accessories & lifestyle |
| `home` | Home & living |
| `fmcg` | Fast-moving consumer goods |

### tier

Automatically computed from `followers`. Do not set this manually.

| Value | Followers Range |
|-------|----------------|
| `Mega` | > 1,000,000 |
| `Macro` | 100,000 – 1,000,000 |
| `Micro` | 10,000 – 100,000 |
| `Nano` | < 10,000 |

### campaign status

| Value | Meaning |
|-------|---------|
| `active` | Campaign running; actual GMV not yet recorded |
| `completed` | Actual GMV recorded; accuracy_pct computed |

## 14. Frontend Integration Checklist

- [ ] Read this file fully before writing any API call
- [ ] Field names copied exactly (case-sensitive)
- [ ] `budget` slider lower bound > 0 (never allow 0)
- [ ] `country` dropdown values uppercase: `MY`, `ID`, `TH`, `PH`, `SG`, `VN`
- [ ] `category` dropdown values lowercase: `beauty`, `fashion`, `home`, `fmcg`
- [ ] Convergence chart reads from all six `results[algo].history` arrays
- [ ] Handle `candidates == 0`: show "No KOLs found for this filter"
- [ ] Handle network error gracefully
- [ ] Campaign Attribution: call `GET /campaigns` on page load
- [ ] KOL History: call `GET /kols/{id}/history` when opening KOL detail modal
- [ ] Tested locally with backend running before opening PR
